About this role

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world’s leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

We are hiring a Marketing Manager

Marketers at Canonical are brand stewards and demand creators.They transform complex open-source technology into messages, stories and strategies that shape the market understanding of our vision. Some focus on differentiated product and portfolio positioning; others specialize in account-based engagement, partner and alliance messaging, or product-led growth. Whatever their specialization, each marketer works as part of a cross-functional unit, contributing campaigns and insights that help the company learn and grow faster.

We have a bias for action, focus efforts on the most impactful activities and take ownership of our results. We work across long buying cycles, balance storytelling with data, design experiments, track outcomes, and iterate rapidly to find what works.

Marketers at Canonical don’t just promote open source; they amplify it, ensuring our innovations reach the right people, at the right time, with clarity and purpose from developers to decision makers.

Location: Remote, EMEA and Americas

What your day will look like

- Own end-to-end go-to-market planning and campaign execution across portfolios, territory or vertical.
- Develop and lead marketing programs that engage with prospects to drive opportunities and revenue.
- Collaborate closely with other marketing teams to improve content performance and conversion through data-driven insights.
- Partner with events, content, paid media, and social media teams to execute integrated campaigns across channels.

What we are looking for in you

- Experience in a marketing role in the technology sector (SaaS or enterprise IT preferred).
- Data-driven mindset with the ability to evaluate performance and optimize for impact.
- Comfortable balancing strategy with hands-on execution, a true self-starter.
- Strong storytelling skills—you know how to craft messaging that resonates with both technical and business audiences.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
- Adaptable, fast learner with a growth mindset and a passion for innovation.

What we offer you

Your base pay will depend on various factors including your geographical location, level of experience, knowledge and skills. In addition to the benefits above, certain roles are also eligible for additional benefits and rewards including annual bonuses and sales incentives based on revenue or utilisation. Our compensation philosophy is to ensure equity right across our global workforce.

In addition to a competitive base pay, we provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. Please note that additional benefits may apply depending on the work location and, for more information on these, please ask your Talent Partner.

- Fully remote working environment – we’ve been working remotely since 2004!
- Personal learning and development budget of 2,000USD per annum
- Annual compensation review
- Recognition rewards
- Annual holiday leave
- Parental Leave
- Employee Assistance Programme
- Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues at ‘sprints’
- Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence – in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do.

Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004.​ Work at Canonical is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical provides a unique window into the world of 21st-century digital business.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

About Smart Working

This role is for a substantial, fast-growing and well-respected UK organisation that has hired several Smart Working professionals before. They are well known for investing in their people and offering a progressive and supportive working environment.

Smart Working recruits excellent people to work full-time, remotely and directly for UK businesses on a long-term basis. Once you pass the interview process with Smart Working, you will be introduced to the company, and if selected, you will work directly with them as part of their team.

About the Role

The role is approximately 60% SEO and 40% hands-on React/Next.js development. You will be responsible for both driving organic growth and independently developing, updating and publishing website pages. Strong practical coding experience is essential, as you must be able to implement website changes yourself rather than relying on developers.

This is a hands-on role: you will implement SEO changes yourself in code (Next.js, React, JavaScript/TypeScript), not just recommend them to developers. It also covers content marketing, analytics and tracking, managing multiple websites, and publishing changes quickly, often the same day. Healthcare/YMYL experience is a strong advantage.

You will use Claude and other AI tools extensively to automate repetitive SEO and marketing work. The role suits a flexible, creative problem-solver who is comfortable in a fast-paced environment.

Responsibilities

- Develop and execute the overall SEO strategy.

- Own technical SEO and continuously identify and resolve issues affecting organic visibility.

- Conduct keyword research, search-intent analysis and competitor research.

- Improve organic rankings, qualified organic traffic and ultimately leads/revenue.

- Develop and execute an SEO-focused content strategy.

- Identify content gaps and opportunities and improve existing content.

- Manage and improve Google Business Profile and local search visibility where relevant.

- Monitor Google rankings, Google Search Console, GA4 and other SEO KPIs.

- Ensure analytics and tracking are correctly configured through GA4 and Google Tag Manager (GTM).

- Build useful reporting and dashboards focused on meaningful business outcomes.

- Use Claude and other AI tools extensively to improve productivity and automate repetitive SEO/marketing tasks.

- Manage tracking, A/B testing and email automation.

- Build WhatsApp agents and web agents.

- Drive YouTube content promotion as an essential part of the role.

- Implement website changes directly in the codebase without depending on a separate development team.

- Create and update website pages, layouts, components and content to support SEO and marketing objectives.

- Implement technical SEO improvements directly within React and Next.js websites.

- Maintain and improve existing websites, ensuring changes are implemented accurately and efficiently.

- Handle website updates and publish changes quickly, including same-day updates when required.

Requirements

- 5+ years of experience in content marketing and SEO content strategy.

- 5+ years of experience driving Google Search and organic ranking growth.

- 5+ years of experience with Google Analytics/GA4 and Google Tag Manager (GTM).

- 5+ years of experience in keyword research and competitor analysis.

- 2+ years of experience with React and Next.js.

- 5+ years of overall experience, at Senior level.

- YouTube content promotion experience is essential.

- Ability to work in a balanced independent and collaborative manner.

- Ability to balance big-picture thinking with attention to detail.

- A strongly flexible and adaptive working style.

- A primarily creative problem-solving approach.

- Ability to operate effectively in a strongly fast-paced environment.

Senior Director, Demand Generation & ABM

Are you obsessed with data, partner success, taking action, and changing the game? If you have a whole lot of hustle and a touch of nerd, come work with Pattern! We want you to use your skills to push one of the fastest-growing companies headquartered in the US to the top of the list. Pattern accelerates brands on global ecommerce marketplaces leveraging proprietary technology and AI. Utilizing more than 66 trillion data points, sophisticated machine learning and AI models, Pattern optimizes and automates all levers of ecommerce growth for global brands, including advertising, content management, logistics and fulfillment, pricing, forecasting and customer service. Hundreds of global brands depend on Pattern’s ecommerce acceleration platform every day to drive profitable revenue growth across 60+ global marketplaces—including Amazon, Walmart.com, Target.com, eBay, Tmall, TikTok Shop, JD, and Mercado Libre. To learn more, visit pattern.com or email press@pattern.com. Pattern has been named one of the fastest growing tech companies headquartered in North America by Deloitte and one of best-led companies by Inc. We place employee experience at the center of our business model and have been recognized as one of Newsweek’s Global Most Loved Workplaces®.

We are looking for a Senior Director, Demand Generation & ABM to build and scale the signal-based, full-funnel engine that drives pipeline, bookings, and revenue for Pattern. You’ll own the demand strategy across target account identification, awareness, engagement, conversion, and post-sale expansion—bringing together paid media, outbound, content, events, lifecycle marketing, and AI-powered tactics into one cohesive motion. This is a full-time role and will work a hybrid schedule based in Lehi, UT.

The Role

- Demand Generation and ABM at Pattern is a signal-based function responsible for the full demand funnel and account lifecycle—from target account identification and awareness through engagement, conversion, and post-sale expansion. This is a full-funnel mandate focused on building pipeline and revenue, not simply generating leads.
- Success in the role will be measured by both the bookings directly sourced by marketing and the bookings marketing influences throughout the buying journey. Because Pattern’s deals often involve multiple channels and stakeholders before closing, the role requires a leader who can connect those touchpoints into a cohesive demand strategy and clearly demonstrate their impact on pipeline and revenue.

What will I need to thrive in this role?

- 15+ years of experience in digital and demand marketing, including 8+ years leading strategy and teams
- Proven experience scaling paid media programs profitably and managing multi-million-dollar budgets across multiple channels
- Experience developing multi-channel campaigns across email, content, events, outbound, and ABM, including complex, multi-stakeholder buying committees
- Proven experience developing lead scoring and lifecycle/nurture programs and driving pipeline velocity
- Strong experience with marketing analytics, attribution, and data-driven budget management
- Experience with Salesforce, Marketo, and BI/reporting platforms, including building and validating lead scoring models
- Experience applying AI and machine learning to marketing, including campaign optimization, personalization, predictive targeting, and creative production
- Proven experience partnering with Sales, RevOps, Product, and Finance, including shared ownership of marketing budgets and go-to-market strategy
- Prior accountability for marketing efficiency, ROI, and/or marketing-sourced and influenced pipeline
- Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field, or equivalent experience

What You'll Own:

- Account strategy and lead scoring. Own the ideal customer profile and target account universe, and sharpen the lead scoring model beneath Pattern's existing tiered account lists against real conversion and close behavior.

- Full funnel orchestration. Run signal based programs across every stage of the demand funnel, target account identification, top of funnel awareness, mid funnel engagement, bottom of funnel conversion, and post sale expansion, coordinating paid, outbound, content, and events into one motion rather than disconnected touches.

- Lifecycle marketing. Build and continually refresh an always on nurture motion across every channel, including email, so prospects and customers keep moving between active campaigns.

- Sales alignment and enablement. Own the operating cadence with the sales team: shared account lists, handoff SLAs, and joint ownership of go to market strategy. Partner with sales to plan and deliver content matched to every stage of the sales cycle, from early education through late stage proof points, so reps always have the right asset to move a deal forward.

- Attribution and budget partnership. Maintain a defensible, auditable view of what spend produces (anchored in Salesforce and Marketo), quantify the bookings marketing sources and influences, and partner directly with the CMO on building, defending, and reallocating the department budget.

- Team leadership. Manage a paid media manager, a team of demand and integrated marketing managers, and a lifecycle marketing manager, all against an efficiency target rather than a flat activity budget. You'll also be asked to build out an autonomous AI layer across the function.

- Martech and AI partnership. Partner with Marketing Technology leadership on the tools and AI systems the team runs on, setting the standard for how the team uses AI without compromising brand judgment or data integrity.

How You Lead:

- Move fluidly between executive level strategy and the operational detail of a single campaign, closing that gap personally.
- Ground strategy in qualitative signal, sales calls, win and loss themes, account feedback, not only dashboards.
- Build cross functional trust by understanding sales and finance priorities first, rather than negotiating from separate camps.
- Have already owned a hard efficiency or ROI target in front of leadership, not just an activity or awareness target.
- Can point to a motion you already rebuilt in response to new tooling or buyer behavior.

How We'll Measure Success:

- Marketing sourced and marketing influenced bookings growth against target
- Pipeline velocity and win rate for target accounts relative to non target accounts
- Expansion revenue within the target account universe, not only new logo acquisition
- Attribution accuracy and auditability
- Lead scoring model accuracy against actual pipeline and win outcomes
- Lifecycle and nurture engagement across channels, including email
- Department budget performance against the CMO's plan

Sounds great! Whats the company culture?

- Game Changers- A game changer is someone who looks at problems with an open mind and shares new ideas with team members, regularly reassesses existing plans and attaches a realistic timeline to goals, makes profitable, productive, and innovative contributions, and actively pursues improvements to Pattern’s processes and outcomes.

- Data Fanatics- A data fanatic is someone who recognizes problems and seeks to understand them through data, draws unbiased conclusions based on data that lead to actionable solutions, and continues to track the effects of the solutions using data.

- Partner Obsessed- An individual who is partner obsessed clearly explains the status of projects to partners and relies on constructive feedback, actively listens to partner’s expectations, and delivers results that exceed them, prioritizes the needs of your partners, and takes the time to create a personable experience for those interacting with Pattern.

- Team of Doers- Someone who is a part of a team of doers uplifts team members and recognizes their specific contributions, takes initiative to help in any circumstance, actively contributes to supporting improvements, and holds themselves accountable to the team as well as to partners.

What is the hiring process?

- Initial phone interview with Pattern’s talent acquisition team

- Video interview with a hiring manager

- Onsite interview with a panel of department leaders

- Professional reference checks

- Executive review

- Offer

How can I stand out as an applicant?

- Discuss professional accomplishments with specific data to quantify examples

- Provide insights on how you can add value and be the best addition to the team

- Focus on mentioning how you would be partner obsessed at Pattern

- Share experience on any side projects related to data and analytics

Why should I work at Pattern? Pattern offers big opportunities to make a difference in the ecommerce industry! We are a company full of talented people that evolves quickly and often. We set big goals, work tirelessly to achieve them, and we love our Pattern community. We also believe in having fun and balancing our lives, so we offer awesome benefits that include: - Unlimited PTO- Paid Holidays- Onsite Fitness Center- Company Paid Life Insurance- Casual Dress Code- Competitive Pay- Health, Vision, and Dental Insurance- 401(k) match. Pattern matches 100% of the first 3% in eligible compensation deferred and 50% of the next 2% in eligible compensation deferred.
